name: Linnaeus's two-toed sloth
desc: A slow leaf-eater of the canopy. In the harpy eagle article sloths are the most important prey group.
about: Linnaeus's two-toed sloth, also known as the southern two-toed sloth, unau, or Linne's two-toed sloth is a species of sloth from South America, found in Venezuela, Suriname, Guyana, French Guiana,…
